# Vendor-directory fixtures (T03 discovery, contract §14.1)

Every file here is **synthesized** from the shapes documented in the research
(R2 session discovery, R5 teammate protocol, R6 live probes). Nothing was copied
from a real machine: no real session ids, paths, prompts or messages.

Content fields (prompts, titles, replies, inbox `text`/`summary`/`result`,
spawn `prompt`, task `description`) carry the canary string
`CANARY-7f3a-CONTENT`; the privacy tests (T-priv-3) assert that it never reaches
logs, diagnostics, the `history_index` table or anything else that persists.

Templates use `{{NAME}}` placeholders that the tests fill in (pids, session ids,
times and paths must match the fake processes a test creates):

| File | Shape |
|---|---|
| `claude/registry/interactive.json` | `<cfg>/sessions/<pid>.json` (2.1.306 keys incl. `peerFeatures`, `pidDomain`, `messagingSocketPath`) |
| `claude/transcripts/normal.jsonl` | metadata rows, `permission-mode`, a human prompt, assistant rows (one block each), a closed tool call, `turn_duration`, `ai-title`, `last-prompt` (tests append `agent-name`, `custom-title`, `continued-in` rows) |
| `claude/transcripts/open_tool.jsonl` | a turn whose last `tool_use` has no `tool_result` yet (S3 open tool) |
| `claude/transcripts/api_error_final.jsonl` | an unrecovered `system/api_error` after the human prompt |
| `claude/transcripts/api_error_recovered.jsonl` | an `api_error` followed by assistant rows (a retried request) |
| `claude/transcripts/teammate.jsonl` | a pane teammate's own transcript (`agentName`, `teamName` on content rows) |
| `claude/transcripts/unknown_rows.jsonl` | unknown row types, a non-JSON row, a row with a wrong type |
| `claude/teams/config.json` | team `config.json` with a lead and a pane member whose `prompt` is content |
| `claude/teams/inbox_team_lead.json` | the lead's inbox with an `idle_notification`, a `permission_request`, a `plan_approval_request`, a `shutdown_approved` and a plain message |
| `claude/tasks/*.json` | task files (`description`/`activeForm` are content and never read) |
| `claude/jobs/state.json`, `claude/daemon/roster.json` | `--bg` job state and the daemon roster (frozen 2.1.307 keys) |
| `codex/rollout.jsonl` | a rollout: `session_meta`, items, `task_complete` |
| `cursor/meta.json` | a cursor chat `meta.json` |
| `agy/last_conversations.json` | agy `cache/last_conversations.json` |

Binary fixtures (SQLite databases, invalid UTF-8 rows, 4.5 MiB lines, the
2.5 k-session History tree, `chmod 000` key files) are generated by the tests at
run time in temp dirs.
